jobs.title: Foundry Program Manager, Service Operations and Program Management
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
Role Summary:
The Foundry Program Manager will play a critical role in advancing Intel Foundry transformation initiatives by driving operational excellence, governance, business process execution, and data-driven decision-making for OSAT-like service offerings. This role is responsible for sustaining service management frameworks, enabling business insights through analytics, enhancing reporting discipline, and ensuring effective cross-functional collaboration among manufacturing, engineering, finance, automation, and business operations teams.

In addition to supporting strategic Foundry transformation objectives, this position requires a strong factory integrator capable of leading and executing new product introductions, process transfers, and technology validation in Assembly and Test Manufacturing sites and being as SPOC to connect upstream facilities within APTM for NPI programs . The successful candidate will serve as a key bridge between development and HVM, ensuring technologies, platforms, and products achieve certification readiness and operational excellence prior to production ramp in ATM.

This role combines strategic program leadership with hands-on manufacturing integration expertise, enabling successful execution of Foundry business models and operational transformation initiatives defined by the ATM Foundry Program Office.

Key Responsibilities:
Foundry Program Focus
• Lead day-to-day execution of Foundry service programs, ensuring effective governance, operational discipline, and performance management.
• Own service metrics, data quality, dashboards, and business-value reporting for operational and executive reviews.
• Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Finance, Automation, and Business Operations teams to ensure accurate service tracking, value realization, and business alignment.
• Support service monetization, cost modeling, and business process governance to enable scalable Foundry operations.
• Drive continuous improvements that enhance service visibility, customer responsiveness, and operational efficiency.
• Develop executive updates, scorecards, benchmarking analyses, and program reviews to support strategic decision-making.
• Maintain service playbooks, operating procedures, and training materials to ensure consistent execution and long-term program sustainability.

ATM Integration Focus:
• Lead New Product Introduction/Integration, factory startup, and process transfer activities across development and manufacturing organizations.
• Own NPI execution, roadmap, milestones, and readiness reviews from initial launch through HVM.
• Serve as the SPOC for assigned programs, driving stakeholder alignment, risk management, and issue resolution.
• Partner with Product Design, PDT, ATTD, Manufacturing, Automation, and Quality teams to ensure product, process, and manufacturing readiness.
• Lead technical reviews and data-driven problem solving to resolve product and process challenges.
• Ensure ES, QS, PRQ, PROD, certification, quality, performance, and customer requirements are achieved.
• Drive continuous improvement of NPI systems, processes, and operational excellence through post-launch learning and optimization.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or a related technical field.
• 5+ years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing, engineering, manufacturing operations, business operations, or program management.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, reporting, and stakeholder management skills.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional programs and drive execution in a complex manufacturing environment.
•
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in semiconductor manufacturing, Foundry, OSAT, NPI, or factory operations.
• Knowledge of product/process integration, manufacturing readiness, and technology transfer processes.
• Experience with KPI dashboards, business analytics, governance frameworks, and operational reporting.
• Understanding of service-based business models, operational benchmarking, and customer-facing manufacturing operations.
• Proficiency in Power BI, Excel, and business process documentation tools.

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
The Role and Impact
As a Logistics Operations Manager, you will oversee logistics operations for inbound, interplant, and outbound materials, equipment, and finished goods, ensuring seamless execution of critical processes that drive Intel's Global Logistics Organization performance. Your role will directly impact operational excellence, ensuring timely deliveries, optimized solutions, and adherence to compliance standards. You will lead key logistics initiatives, resolve escalations, and contribute to continuous improvement efforts that enhance cost efficiency, speed, quality, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage logistics operations for inbound, interplant, and outbound shipments of materials, equipment, and finished goods, ensuring continuity of deliveries.

- Provide dock operations ownership to support site start-up, ramp, and steady-state logistics execution.

- Monitor and drive performance against logistics KPIs, compliance requirements, and operational standards.

- Analyze logistics processes and data to identify inefficiencies, defects, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

- Track, escalate, and resolve shipping, warehouse, carrier, and execution exceptions.

- Lead critical logistics escalations to minimize disruptions and ensure customer satisfaction.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external logistics providers to optimize supply chain execution.

- Leverage analytical and digital tools to develop solutions that enhance cost, speed, quality, and reliability.

- Deliver regular updates to senior leaders on logistics performance, risk assessments, and operational readiness.

- Anticipate business and customer needs, ensuring operational readiness to support capacity growth, customer ramps, and strategic initiatives.

- Drive a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across internal teams and external logistics providers.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or a related field.

- Minimum 4 years of experience in logistics operations or 3PL management with a Bachelor's degree; or 3 years of experience with a Master's degree.

- Expertise in warehouse operations, compliance, and supplier governance, with a proven track record of owning execution end-to-end.

- Proficiency in SAP/WMS systems, inventory control, and performance metric tracking, with demonstrated ability to identify issues and implement corrective actions.

- Strong analytical skills, with experience in translating data into actionable decisions and sustained improvements.

- Technical proficiency in monitoring logistics KPIs and driving operational excellence.

Preferred Qualifications
- Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and rapidly changing operational environment.

- Demonstrated track record of taking initiative, driving results independently, and leading through ambiguity.

- Strong sense of ownership and urgency, with the ability to balance strategic priorities and day-to-day operational execution.

- Experience supporting customer ramps, operational transformations, or large-scale logistics readiness initiatives.

jobs.title: Business Development Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
- We are looking for an enthusiastic Business Development Specialist located in Taiwan to identify and engage with ecosystem and industry partners to optimize or build solutions around Intel Edge platforms and software, drive the adoption of Intel Edge AI Systems across the Asia Pacific (APJ) region, support the Intel Early Access Program, and facilitate key events and meetings in the region.

- You will be part of a global business development and technical enablement team that is the Centre of Excellence for Intel's Edge ISV Enabling efforts.

- The team is the main point of contact between our engineering teams, vertical business units, sales and marketing teams and our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) partners.

- You will work directly with a Business Development Manager to identify high-potential Edge ISVs in the Asia Pacific Region, help them optimize their AI models on Intel architecture (using tools like OpenVINO), and onboard them into our Edge ISV Program, acting as our evangelist who unlocks business value for our partners.

Key Responsibilities include:
1. ISV Onboarding
- Solution Mapping: Assess the needs of potential ISV partners and map them to the correct Intel software offerings, and onboard as qualified Intel Edge AI Applications.

- Architecture Advisory: specific to Open Edge Platform (OEP) and Edge AI Suites, provide high-level guidance on how ISVs can leverage the platform to scale their applications across diverse hardware configurations.

2. Program Enablement and Evangelism
Edge ISV Program Management: Serve as the regional expert on the Edge ISV Program, articulate the tiers, benefits, and marketing support available to partners.
- Value Proposition Coaching: Train ISV business and product leaders on the competitive advantages of Intel's Edge AI portfolio. Help them understand the TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and performance benefits of migrating to Intel architecture.

- Events and Workshops: Coordinate with Business Development managers on ISV engagement activities for Intel and/or Industry events

- Software Early Access: Collaborate with SW EA program manager and technical support team to support pre-launch ISV enablement and track enablement progress.

3. Regional Business Development
- Partner Recruitment: Proactively identify and recruit high-value ISVs in key verticals and countries across the APJ region who have scalable applications in Edge AI, especially in Taiwan, Japan and/or Korea.

- Commercial Alignment: Work with ISVs and sales team to package their software with Intel hardware, creating Edge AI Applications and Solutions and scale via channels and partners across the ecosystem.

- Pipeline Management: Track ISV engagement progress and deployment numbers, reporting on the Edge AI KPIs for the region.

- Localization: Bridge the cultural and business gap between Global HQ and partners in region ensuring that program messaging resonates with local market nuances.

Qualifications:
Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a related field.

- Minimum 3+ years of experience in Technical Sales, Business Development, Product Marketing, or Partner/Alliance Management within the Edge, AI, IoT industry.

- Familiarity with the Intel software ecosystem (OpenVINO, oneAPI, Open Edge Platform) is a strong plus, but candidate's trainability is the key.

- Experience in managing external stakeholders and navigating complex organizational structures.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Proven track record of Business Development experience with ISV companies

- Strong public speaking skills; comfortable presenting to both Product Managers and C-Level executives.

- Exposure to Intel architecture

- Language: English proficiency. Must be able to conduct business negotiations, explain program benefits, and manage relationships in English.

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager, Silicon Photonics
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
The Senior Business Development Manager leads go-to-market and business development for Intel's silicon photonics portfolio within Integrated Photonics Solutions (IPS). Reporting to Jonathan Doylend, this role owns the path from technology to revenue: defining where IPS competes, winning the customers and partners that matter, and turning design engagements into committed business.

Optical connectivity is becoming a requirement for AI and data center scaling, and the window to establish position is now. You will lead engagements with hyperscalers, cloud service providers, OEMs, ODMs, and silicon and system partners across optical compute interconnect, co-packaged optics, and optical engines. You will shape the commercial model, drive design wins, and bring a clear customer view back into the IPS roadmap.

This is a senior, externally facing leadership role with direct accountability for pipeline, design wins, and revenue growth.

Responsibilities
Define and lead the IPS go-to-market strategy, including target segments, priority accounts, positioning, and value proposition.
Build and own the business development pipeline, from first engagement through design win, contract, and volume ramp.
Lead executive-level engagements with hyperscalers, cloud service providers, OEMs, ODMs, and strategic silicon and system partners.
Structure and negotiate commercial agreements, including pricing, supply commitments, joint development, and partnership terms.
Own revenue and design-win targets, and report pipeline, forecast, and business performance to IPS leadership.
Translate customer and market requirements into product and roadmap priorities in partnership with IPS engineering and product teams.
Track the competitive and standards landscape, including co-packaged optics adoption and relevant industry consortia, and adjust strategy accordingly.
Represent Intel silicon photonics at customer briefings, industry events, and ecosystem forums.
Partner with Intel sales, marketing, legal, finance, and DCG account teams to align account plans and close business.

Successful Candidate Profile
Proven record of winning and growing business for complex semiconductor, optical, or data center products.
Strong technical fluency in silicon photonics, optical interconnect, or high-speed data center networking.
Established relationships with hyperscale, cloud, or OEM decision-makers.
Skilled negotiator with experience structuring multi-year commercial and partnership agreements.
Strategic thinker who can turn market insight into a focused go-to-market plan and execute against it.
Clear, confident communicator with executives, both inside Intel and with customers.
Comfortable leading in an emerging market where business models and standards are still forming.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optics, Computer Engineering, Business, or a related field.
12+ years of experience in the semiconductor, optical, networking, or data center industry.
8+ years in business development, strategic sales, or go-to-market leadership roles.
Demonstrated track record of closing design wins or commercial agreements with major technology customers.
Ability to work from Santa Clara, California or another approved Intel U.S. site, with travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications
Master's degree, MBA, or PhD in a relevant engineering, physical science, or business discipline.
Direct experience selling or developing silicon photonics, optical transceivers, co-packaged optics, or optical engines.
Existing relationships with hyperscaler or cloud infrastructure, networking, or AI system teams.
Experience bringing a new technology category to market and building its commercial model.
Familiarity with optical and networking standards bodies and industry consortia.

jobs.title: Director of Data Governance and Operations
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
Overview

We are seeking an exceptional Director of Data Governance with a strong focus on accelerating business transformation through data management and operations excellence. The Director will play a pivotal role in ensuring that business requirements are thoroughly understood and effectively translated into IT solutions, with a keen vision for business process management and transformation. Expertise in industry standards and a deep understanding of master data for ERP and supply chain are critical for success in this role.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead business transformation initiatives by leveraging data as a strategic asset.
- Define and execute the data governance strategy to ensure data quality and governance.
- Drive innovation in data operations to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
- Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and IT teams to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and translated into IT solutions.
- Stay current with industry standards and best practices related to data management, ERP, and supply chain.
- Apply expertise in master data management for ERP systems and supply chain processes to improve data quality and operational efficiency.
- Collaborate closely with senior leadership to align data initiatives with overall business objectives.
- Provide visionary leadership to the data governance team, fostering collaboration across IT, business analysts, and executives.
- Manage the budget for data governance and invest in the professional growth of the data operations team.
- Ensure the highest levels of data security and privacy are maintained.
- Provide regular reports to senior management on data governance, performance, and progress of business transformation initiatives.

Qualifications:
Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Management, or Business), Master's degree preferred.
- Extensive experience in data operations and data management with a minimum of 10 years in a leadership role.

Preferred Experience and Skills
- Prior experience in Data Transformation.
- Exceptional understanding of data governance principles and best practices.
- Proven expertise in data quality tools and methodologies.
- Deep knowledge of data management software and tools (e.g., data warehouses, ETL tools, data modeling tools).
- Ability to develop, define, and execute operational processes
- Advanced understanding of data security and privacy best practices.

Job Details:

Job Description:
The Role and Impact
We are seeking a dynamic individual to lead global supply chain engineering and commercial teams in optimizing supply chain performance and fostering supplier relationships in support of Advanced Packaging Technology and Manufacturing (APTM) operations. In this role, you will drive operational excellence by integrating supplier strategies with Intel's manufacturing capabilities, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to develop and implement strategies across global manufacturing sites.

Business group
Strategic Parts and Service Supply Chain (SPSC) is part of the Foundry Construction and Sourcing (FCS) team in Intel Foundry. We play a pivotal role in developing and managing supply chain solutions supporting Intel Foundry's wafer/packaging development and manufacturing operations.

- Lead global supply chain teams to optimize supplier performance and operational efficiency through clear metrics, market intelligence, and continuous improvement.
- Build strategic supplier partnerships to drive long-term engineering and supply chain roadmaps aligned with future technological needs.
- Lead benchmarking and industry intelligence to drive supplier and technology improvements in factory equipment spares and service products.
- Provide leadership through goal setting, facilitating team execution, maintaining accountability, and driving performance management practices.
- Inspire and develop teams to achieve results while role modeling Intel values and creating a productive work environment.

- Proficiency in disciplined execution, data analysis tools, and supply chain optimization techniques.

- Track record of driving meaningful change and continuous improvement in a global supply chain environment.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Construction and Facilities Supply Chain (CFSC)
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
- The Construction and Facilities Supply Chain (CFSC) leader is accountable for the delivery of all construction and contract management activities worldwide including sourcing, competitive strategies, contract development/administration, and supplier management for design, construction, facilities construction M+E, logistics, real estate, utility strategies, infrastructure and delivery. The leader partners and collaborates with the construction execution teams, Foundry partners and customer organizations and/or stakeholders to deliver optimized construction and facilities solutions maximizing wafer output. This position reports to an Intel Foundry Corporate Vice President who owns capacity delivery for Intel Foundry.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- Deliver best-in-class commercial outcomes by deploying contractual levers, disciplined negotiation strategies, robust scope and budget controls, outsourced/offshore contracting capabilities, and workflow tools to drive speed, accountability, risk mitigation, and execution excellence.
- Proactively lead pre-construction planning, proposal development, supplier engagement, and pricing strategy well ahead of negotiations by aligning critical internal partners, shaping execution strategies, testing market assumptions, and building supplier-informed plans that strengthen commercial readiness and negotiation outcomes.
- Use industry benchmarks and performance metrics as the baseline, to build credible, aggressive, and data-backed negotiation positions that consistently outperform market standards and deliver better-than-benchmark results.
- Lead global executive alignment and supplier engagement to build strategic partnerships that deliver stronger commercial outcomes. Apply contracting, compensation, and supply chain levers with discipline to protect Intel’s interests, reduce cost and cycle time, mitigate claims, and drive optimal results. Own supplier performance against contractual commitments by tracking key metrics, identifying deviations early, and driving corrective actions with urgency and accountability.
- Lead a high-performing, delivery-focused organization by setting clear priorities, creating accountability for outcomes, removing barriers to execution, developing strong leaders, and building a culture of ownership, urgency, collaboration, and disciplined follow-through across complex global construction and supply chain programs.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree required, Engineering or MBA background strongly desired with 15+ years of experience in construction contracts and/or program management or related fields.
- Progressive and dynamic leadership experience, in a high growth and fast paced organization.
- Experience growing, managing and developing a large team of an industry-leading construction capability to support large scale, multi-billion-dollar projects.
- Must have an executive presence in engaging with suppliers at the C Suite level with constructive confrontation and collaboration
- Ability to excel in leading in a highly matrixed development environment

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
The Role and Impact
As a Partner Marketing Manager, you will lead and drive impactful co-marketing initiatives with Intel's strategic partner Microsoft, ensuring alignment with Intel's brand strategies and delivering measurable business results. You will evaluate market trends and competitive programs, manage multi-region campaigns, and guide partners in utilizing Market Development Funds (MDF) effectively. Your expertise will play a critical role in developing metrics to analyze marketing spend and return on investment, empowering Intel and its partners to collaboratively achieve success in the marketplace.
In this role, you will work alongside the Global Field Sales, Business Groups, global and regional marketing, and sales counterparts that are at points of influence throughout the world. You will work directly with partners at Microsoft and build relationships, from mid-level to the most senior managers within their marketing and sales organizations.
This role is responsible for driving strategic decisions that align Microsoft and Intel's global GTM strategies and regional execution engines that materially and measurably contribute to business growth across all segments. In this customer-facing role that must be located in Seattle, WA or Portland, OR, your leadership will be critical to champion the design, activation, iteration, and ongoing measurement of results across key lines of Intel + Microsoft business in consumer, commercial client and data center segments.

Key Responsibilities
- Partner with the sales team to drive an integrated 4P GTM strategy that supports the account team revenue goals
- Drive alignment across the sales and marketing teams at Intel and Microsoft for execution of investment in sales and marketing activities.
- Work with the Microsoft global and regional marketing teams to develop a full-funnel marketing strategy across the entire investment portfolio, driving measurable impact for the business.
- Lead a team of marketers to build co-branded campaigns, custom product messaging integration, and competitive marketing content.
- Direct multi-region and global co-marketing programs and campaigns to jointly sell with partners and Intel's Industry Sales team.
- Develop and oversee partner participation requirements for promotional activities linked to specific products or product lines.
- Evaluate and manage new strategic business opportunities with partners, ensuring alignment with Intel's objectives.
- Monitor competitive partner marketing programs and channel trends, adjusting strategies to optimize performance.
- Ensure all partner marketing communications and content reflect Intel's brand strategies.
- Guide and support partners in utilizing Market Development Funds (MDF), ensuring compliance with guidelines and enabling effective marketing initiatives.
- Drive internal reporting and analyze metrics related to partner marketing spend and return on investment, both at the program level and by key accounts.
- Report key performance metrics to Sales and Marketing leadership, providing actionable insights to drive improvements.
- Inspire and enable teams through goal setting, fostering accountability, and driving differentiated performance management to achieve results.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field with 8+ years of relevant experience
- 5+ years in a customer facing role in a Global Sales or Marketing organization
- Proven expertise in executing co-marketing programs and campaigns on a global scale.
- Proficiency in analyzing marketing metrics and generating actionable insights.
- Demonstrated ability to manage Market Development Funds (MDF) and partner relationships effectively.
- Strong knowledge of competitive programs, market trends, and channel dynamics.
- Ability to travel at least once per quarter.

Preferred Qualifications
- Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, a strong sense of leadership.
- Experience in building and maintaining strategic relationships with partners and cross-functional teams.
- Ability to lead diverse teams, inspire collaboration, and drive results in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong communication skills with expertise in presenting to senior stakeholders.
- Strategic thinker with a track record of aligning marketing initiatives with broader business goals.

We are excited about the potential you bring to this role and encourage you to apply, contributing your skills and expertise to help shape Intel's success alongside a team of forward-thinking professionals.

Job Description:
Job Description:
Intel Corporation is a global leader in technology innovation, shaping the future with groundbreaking advancements in computing and communications. Our mission is to create world-changing technology that enriches the lives of every person on earth. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives drive our success.

We are seeking a dynamic and customer-focused ASUS Partner Marketing Manager to join our Marketing team. In this pivotal role, you will lead strategic initiatives and align global go-to-market (GTM) strategies to achieve growth targets and drive impactful results. Based in Taipei city, you will collaborate with global teams, build executive networks, and engage directly with partners at Asus to champion innovation and drive business priorities.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead cross-functional teams and align Asus and Intel's global GTM strategies.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with Asus' marketing and sales organizations.
- Drive an integrated 4P GTM strategy in partnership with the sales team to support goals.
- Develop and execute a full-funnel marketing strategy across the portfolio, driving measurable impact.
- Collaborate and guide a team of partner marketers to create co-branded campaigns, custom product messaging integration, and exciting marketing content.
- Define metrics and KPIs to measure the execution of go-to-market strategies and launch initiatives.
- Manage global marketing budgets, reviews and approvals.
- Serve as a central point between corporate and field teams, ensuring alignment on business results and action plans.
- Exemplify Intel's core values.

- Strategic vision with an eye toward innovation, test and learn and optimization.
- Exceptional communication skills and attention to detail.
- Strong leadership skills with a proven track record of guiding cross-functional teams.
- Experience in project and program management, with the willingness to function well in a fluid environment.
- A data-driven approach with the skills to take calculated risks and measure business impact.
- The skills to define and drive short and long-term strategic direction and translate it into actionable initiatives.
- A growth mindset with the desire and initiative to be curious, agile, and responsive to market conditions.

Join us at Intel and be part of a team that is driving innovation and shaping the future of technology. If you are ready to take on this exciting challenge, we encourage you to apply
